strips.title: Acorn Errand Label Strip
strips.useCase: Adult-led offline paper strip for turning one pretend errand-office object into a short story start.
strips.adultSetup: Print one strip, place it with a pencil, and invite the writer to fill one pretend errand label: ____________________.
strips.kidDirection: Invent one tiny desk object for Acorn Avenue, then write what errand it helps with: ____________________.
strips.stripFrontPrompt: Front prompt: The errand office object on my desk strip is ____________________.
strips.stripBackPrompt: Back prompt: This object belongs in the drawer marked ____________________ because ____________________.
strips.storySeedPrompt: Story seed: A small helper finds ____________________ tucked under the errand counter.
strips.firstLinePath: First line path: At Acorn Avenue Errand Office, ____________________ is waiting beside ____________________.
strips.revisionNudge: Revision nudge: Add one exact object detail that makes the errand clearer: ____________________.
strips.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Sketch the object first, then label it with one word: ____________________.
strips.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Start another errand story with this desk object: ____________________.

strips.title: Penny Path Compass Choice Strip
strips.useCase: Adult-led offline paper strip for helping a writer choose one pretend direction and one story reason.
strips.adultSetup: Print one strip, set it on the writing desk, and choose a safe pretend compass mark to fill in: ____________________.
strips.kidDirection: Pick one compass mark in the Penny Path shop and decide what it points toward: ____________________.
strips.stripFrontPrompt: Front prompt: My compass shop mark points toward ____________________.
strips.stripBackPrompt: Back prompt: The shopkeeper notices the mark change when ____________________.
strips.storySeedPrompt: Story seed: A penny-sized compass turns toward ____________________ instead of the usual shelf.
strips.firstLinePath: First line path: Inside the Penny Path Compass Shop, ____________________ points to ____________________.
strips.revisionNudge: Revision nudge: Replace one plain direction with a clearer route clue: ____________________.
strips.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Draw one arrow, then write the place it points to: ____________________.
strips.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Use this compass clue to begin a new paper story: ____________________.

strips.title: Seed Library Drawer Strip
strips.useCase: Adult-led offline paper strip for building a calm map-room setting from one invented drawer detail.
strips.adultSetup: Print the strip, place it beside a blank sheet, and ask the writer to invent a drawer label: ____________________.
strips.kidDirection: Name one map-room drawer, add one setting detail, and write why it matters today: ____________________.
strips.stripFrontPrompt: Front prompt: The drawer label in the Seed Library Map Room reads ____________________.
strips.stripBackPrompt: Back prompt: Inside the drawer, the map shows ____________________ near ____________________.
strips.storySeedPrompt: Story seed: The seed map changes after someone adds ____________________ to the drawer.
strips.firstLinePath: First line path: In the map room, ____________________ waits under the label ____________________.
strips.revisionNudge: Revision nudge: Add one where-detail so the reader can picture the map room: ____________________.
strips.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Outline the drawer shape, then write its label: ____________________.
strips.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: At another desk, add one new map-room clue: ____________________.

strips.title: Rain Gauge Signal Strip
strips.useCase: Adult-led offline paper strip for collecting color, sound, and motion words before a short railway scene.
strips.adultSetup: Print one strip, keep it paper-only, and ask the writer to choose a soft signal word: ____________________.
strips.kidDirection: Choose one color, one quiet sound, and one small movement for the rain-gauge railway: ____________________.
strips.stripFrontPrompt: Front prompt: The rain gauge signal looks ____________________ and sounds like ____________________.
strips.stripBackPrompt: Back prompt: The railway helper understands the signal because ____________________.
strips.storySeedPrompt: Story seed: The gauge line rises to ____________________, and the little railway changes course.
strips.firstLinePath: First line path: Beside the Rain Gauge Railway, ____________________ makes the signal feel important.
strips.revisionNudge: Revision nudge: Trade one vague describing word for a sharper sensory word: ____________________.
strips.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Circle one color word, then copy it here: ____________________.
strips.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Begin a railway scene with this safe signal detail: ____________________.

strips.title: Moss Message Pattern Strip
strips.useCase: Adult-led offline paper strip for turning one pretend moss pattern into a clear story clue.
strips.adultSetup: Print the strip, set a pencil beside it, and invite the writer to invent one moss pattern: ____________________.
strips.kidDirection: Design a pretend moss message, then write what the observatory helper notices first: ____________________.
strips.stripFrontPrompt: Front prompt: The moss message pattern looks like ____________________.
strips.stripBackPrompt: Back prompt: The pattern repeats near ____________________ and seems to mean ____________________.
strips.storySeedPrompt: Story seed: A new moss mark appears on ____________________ just before ____________________.
strips.firstLinePath: First line path: At the quiet observatory, ____________________ appears beside ____________________.
strips.revisionNudge: Revision nudge: Add one repeated shape, line, or texture to make the pattern clearer: ____________________.
strips.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Draw the pattern quietly, then name it: ____________________.
strips.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Save this moss pattern as the first clue in another story: ____________________.

strips.title: Tidepool Lab Sequence Strip
strips.useCase: Adult-led offline paper strip for planning a first, next, and finally path inside a pretend tidepool lab.
strips.adultSetup: Print one strip, place it with a pencil, and ask the writer to choose the first lab note: ____________________.
strips.kidDirection: Write three paper-only tidepool lab steps: first ____________________, next ____________________, finally ____________________.
strips.stripFrontPrompt: Front prompt: The tidepool lab note begins with ____________________.
strips.storySeedPrompt: Story seed: The lab helper changes the order after noticing ____________________ in the tidepool tray.
strips.revisionNudge: Revision nudge: Add one clear transition word or step detail to the middle: ____________________.
strips.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Number the three steps, then write the strongest one: ____________________.
strips.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Use this sequence to start a new tidepool lab paragraph: ____________________.
